task: Verify and finish the native Pulse Lab session toy against these requirements using the current production sources. Choose the next useful actions and continue until verified or a bounded blocker is demonstrated.

requirements.text: On launch the session says Idle and Count 0; Start is available.
Start enters Running and keeps Count 0.
Each Step adds exactly one while Running. Step is absent while Idle or Paused.
Pause enters Paused and preserves Count. Resume enters Running and preserves Count.
Reset from either Running or Paused clears Count to 0 and returns to Idle.
The separate Preview Pause/Resume control changes only Preview Moving/Still; it preserves session phase and count.
Session and Preview actions expose distinct, stable native accessibility identifiers and accessible names. Every visible action is uniquely resolvable in the native tree.
In Idle, Running, and Paused, the phase, count, and visible action labels are readable without clipping or overlap.

authorization: Local production source fixes, local build/relaunch, native observations, and reversible fixture UI actions are approved. External publication is outside this fixture.
